surface.title: Exercises
surface.description: Fill in each entry below, then press Check. Grading is instant and deterministic — no model is called, and nothing here completes the exercise for you.
surface.empty: This lesson has no interactive exercises yet.

journal.correct: Correct — the entry balances and every account and amount is right.
journal.incorrect: Not quite. Nothing here tells you the answer — read the notes and try again.
journal.invalid: Fix the highlighted rows before checking.
journal.saveFailed: The attempt could not be saved. Your entry is still here — try Check again.

issue.unbalanced: The debit total and the credit total do not match.
issue.invalid_amount: Row {n} on the {side} side needs a positive whole-yen amount.
issue.missing_account: Row {n} has an amount but no account.
issue.unknown_account: Row {n} uses an account that is not offered here.
issue.account_not_right: One account on the {side} side is not right for this transaction.
issue.amount_wrong: The amount on row {n} of the {side} side is off.
issue.wrong_side: One account is on the wrong side of the entry.
issue.extra_row: The {side} side has one row more than this transaction needs.
issue.needs_more_rows: The {side} side still needs another row.
